description: Implementation of cryptographically secure random number generation functions, including thread-local state management, entropy collection, and reseeding logic, with FIPS compliance considerations.

methods.name: rand_thread_state_free
methods.description: Frees thread-local RNG state, called when a thread exits.

methods.name: rand_thread_state_clear_all
methods.description: Clears all thread RNG states, used during process shutdown in FIPS mode.

methods.name: rdrand
methods.description: Attempts to fill buffer with hardware RDRAND instruction, fallback if unavailable.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_seed_entropy
methods.description: Obtains seed entropy, using RDRAND or system source depending on FIPS mode.

methods.name: RAND_load_entropy
methods.description: Loads external entropy into the global entropy buffer in FIPS mode.

methods.name: get_seed_entropy
methods.description: Retrieves seed entropy from the global buffer, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: rand_get_seed
methods.description: Generates seed and additional input for CTR-DRBG, with CRNGT checks in FIPS mode.

methods.name: RAND_bytes_with_additional_data
methods.description: Generates random bytes with optional user additional data, managing thread-local state and reseeding.
